payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare the SOURCE and EDITED images, tracking the source blue mug by its visible appearance and context. Fulfillment requires that this same mug—not a different or newly appearing mug—be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. A mug appearing on the right does not establish fulfillment if the source mug is not shown there. Score partial only when the tracked source mug shows concrete movement toward the right of the headphones but has not reached that position; if identity or continuity cannot be determined from the images, treat the evidence as insufficient.
node.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: track that mug by its blue appearance and visual context; distinguish it from the white mugs. Assess whether the source mug itself is visibly to the right of the headphones, rather than counting a different mug or a blurred remnant as the moved mug.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
node.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
node.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
node.zero_when: The source blue mug is not shown to have moved toward the right of the headphones; a different mug on the right or unrelated edits do not count.
node.half_when: The source blue mug is visibly tracked and has moved toward the right of the headphones, but remains short of being positioned to their right, with a concrete remaining positional deficiency.
node.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.

node_traces.evidence: The source light-blue mug is on the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blue blurred remnant remains on the left, while the visible mugs on the right are white; the original blue mug is not visibly identifiable as having moved to the right of the headphones. A different mug on the right does not fulfill the condition.

That is ambiguous evidence of partial progress, not proof that the requested change is absent. Refine the criterion to distinguish visible evidence of an attempted transformation or displacement from mere residual blur, while requiring concrete image evidence before assigning partial; do not infer continuity solely from the right-side mug or force the reference label. Have the evaluator explicitly compare object location, appearance, and scene changes, and return unresolved when the remnant cannot be reliably linked to movement. The trace is valid, queried, and dependency-free, so this is a semantic calibration issue, not a transport/schema failure. Its high confidence should not substitute for resolving the ambiguity."}
